title: Govern edits to context as well as access to it
text: The addendum discusses information lifecycle and authority to edit, approve or retire shared context. A company can have accurate retrieval and still produce bad answers when an unreviewed definition or obsolete instruction is promoted into its common knowledge layer.
qualification: Compiler synthesis, not a proven vendor capability or a fully specified information-governance standard.
